name: careerforge-ai
description: CareerForge AI — local-first multi-agent career-intelligence platform (flagship vertical slice).

scripts.postinstall: echo "Frontend deps installed. Set up the backend with: pip install -e ./apps/api  (see README.md). Windows users: use scripts/setup.ps1 and scripts/dev.ps1."

comments.note: This root package.json only orchestrates the Next.js frontend in apps/web. The Python backend (apps/api) is managed with pip/venv — see README.md.
comments.windows: On Windows, prefer scripts/setup.ps1 and scripts/dev.ps1 which boot BOTH the Python backend and the frontend. `npm run dev` here starts only the frontend.
comments.unix: On macOS/Linux, `bash scripts/dev.sh` boots both processes; `npm run dev` starts only the frontend.
